samples.summary: `sheets export --dry-run` test claims "without fetching or writing the file" but never asserts no file is written
samples.evidence: The test at read-dry-run.test.ts:181-190 asserts only `getCells` was not called and the printed JSON. `writeFileSync` (imported by src/commands/sheets-export.ts:2) is neither spied nor mocked, so if the dry-run branch fell through and wrote `out.csv` into the test cwd the assertion set would be unchanged (getCells is mocked and would still be recorded... actually it would be called, but the file half of the title is entirely unasserted). The 'writing' half of the claimed behaviour has no assertion.

samples.summary: `files list` validate-before-dry-run behaviour (BLOB_TYPES check) has no test, unlike the equivalent `docs list --type` case
samples.evidence: files.ts:83-88 adds a comment asserting the `--type` check runs BEFORE the dry-run branch, mirroring docs.ts. read-dry-run.test.ts covers `docs list --type slides --dry-run` (line 121) and `sheets export --file-format xlsx --dry-run` (line 192) but has no `files list --type <bogus> --dry-run` case; the parameterised `files list` case (line 207) passes no --type. Nothing would catch reordering the two branches in files.ts.

samples.summary: New module `url.ts` has no direct unit test; `seg('')` empty-segment rejection and the server trailing-slash normalisation are untested
samples.evidence: There is no packages/cli/test/url*.test.ts (glob of packages/cli/test/*.test.ts). `seg` is only exercised indirectly through HttpClient/commands with non-empty values, so the `encoded === ''` arm of the guard at url.ts:33 and `origin()`'s `replace(/\/$/, '')` at url.ts:45 (which both apiV1Base and apiKeysUrl depend on, and which the dry-run preview now shares) have no covering assertion — e.g. no test uses `server: 'https://api.example.test/'`.

samples.summary: `seg(replace)` added to the three import dry-run previews is only exercised with benign ids; no traversal/dot-segment case
samples.evidence: docs/import.ts:156, notes/import.ts:148 and slides/import.ts:183 now route `replace` through `seg()` with comments claiming the preview must match the live PUT. The existing import dry-run tests (docs-import.test.ts:339, and the notes/slides equivalents) only pass `replace: 'doc-existing'`, so the escaping and the `..` rejection in these three call sites would still pass if `seg()` were reverted to raw interpolation there.

samples.summary: The `--range` branch of the new `sheets export` dry-run preview is untested
samples.evidence: sheets-export.ts:46-52 builds `?range=${encodeURIComponent(range)}` in the dry-run branch, but read-dry-run.test.ts:181 only runs `sheets export doc-1 out.csv --dry-run` with no `--range`, asserting the range-less URL. The range-encoding half of the added code (the part the comment says mirrors `HttpClient.getCells`) has no covering assertion. (`sheets cells get` does test its range branch at line 168, but that is a different code path.)

samples.summary: The `%2e` alternatives in the DOT_SEGMENT regex are unreachable, and the test presented as covering them actually demonstrates they are dead
samples.evidence: `seg()` tests the regex against `encodeURIComponent(value)`, which always escapes `%` to `%25`, so `encoded` can never contain `%2e` — the `%2e` branches of `/^(?:\.|%2e){1,2}$/i` (url.ts:13) can never match. The test 'is neutralised, not refused, when the id merely spells one out' (http-client-paths.test.ts:161) asserts exactly that (`%2e%2e` → `%252e%252e`), i.e. it proves the branch is dead rather than covering it. No test can exercise those alternatives, so a regression that deleted them would be invisible.

samples.summary: The empty-precomputed-resolution fail-safe test now short-circuits at the push-to-main gate, so it no longer exercises the fall-through it is named for
samples.evidence: resolve() (scripts/changed-areas.mjs:530) returns FULL for push/main immediately after the WAFFLEBASE_CHANGED_AREAS block, before readCiConfig/git-diff. Adding GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push / GITHUB_REF_NAME=main to the test (changed-areas.test.mjs:720-730) means `full === true` is now guaranteed by the deploy gate, and the test's own comment says the empty string 'must be ignored so resolution continues' — but resolution now stops one line later. The added `/push to main/` match does still distinguish the empty-string-parsed-as-invalid-JSON regression, so the test is not fully vacuous, but the deeper fall-through path it claims to protect is no longer covered by any case in this suite.

finding.summary: New empty-segment rejection in `seg()` has no test, and it is the branch most likely to fire in normal use (unconfigured workspace defaults to `''`)
finding.evidence: `seg()` now throws for `encoded === ''` (url.ts:33). `resolveConfig` defaults `workspace` to `''` in all four branches (packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:100,126,147,164) and config.test.ts:30 asserts that default, so with no workspace configured every command (live and --dry-run) now throws `Invalid identifier ""` instead of the previously-documented `/workspaces//...` 404 path (comment at config.ts:108 and config.test.ts:101-104 still describe that old behaviour). No test exercises the empty case: the new suites only cover `..` (http-client-paths.test.ts:131-159, read-dry-run.test.ts:299-320). The new behaviour and the new user-facing error message for the most common misconfiguration ship untested.

verdict.reason: Verified the behavior exists (url.ts:33 throws for `encoded === ''`, reached via `seg(config.workspace)` at url.ts:50 and url.ts:61) and that no test anywhere exercises it. Repo-wide grep for "Invalid identifier" yields only http-client-paths.test.ts:135,150,157 and read-dry-run.test.ts:310,317 — all of which pass a literal '..' (revokeApiKey('..'), getDocument('..'), workspace: '..', `api-keys revoke ..`, `docs get ..`), never an empty string. No test file imports url.ts, so there is no unit test of seg() in any package. I also checked outside packages/cli/test: backend e2e specs that drive the CLI set WAFFLEBASE_WORKSPACE to a real value and contain no matches, and output.test.ts:230 sets workspace 'ws-1'. Targeted greps for empty-string arguments and `workspace: ''`/`workspaces//` in the CLI test dir return only unrelated hits (parsePageRange(''), resolveImageUrl(..., ''), csv cells). config.test.ts:30 asserts the '' default and the comment at config.test.ts:99-104 still describes the old `/api/v1/workspaces//documents` 404 path, confirming the branch is reachable and untested/unupdated. Missing test for a new behavior branch = major under this lens.
